source.title: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

items.name: Sack of Spiders
items.text:
Trigger The death drider is reduced to 0 Hit Points

---

Effect The death drider explodes in a shower of spiders. Each adjacent creature must succeed at a DC 31 Reflex save save or take 3d6 piercing damage and be exposed to death drider venom.

items.name: Death Drider Venom
items.text:
The drained condition persists after the poison's duration ends

Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d8 poison damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 3d8 poison damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 4d8 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round)

items.name: Hungering Web
items.text: A creature hit by a death drider's web attack is Immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface (escape dc=31). Each round thereafter until it breaks free, the creature takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 31 basic Reflex save save) and, on a failed save, is exposed to death drider venom.
